Gazette Trail Reader

Look up a real Indian gazette notification and see what it amends, supersedes, or corrects — and what later amended, superseded, or corrected it — in plain language. A reading aid built from Gazette Trail, an independent citation-index research project, covering 2,591 real notifications across 53 central ministries and departments. Background: the accompanying article on masaladeutsch.

        What this tool is and isn't. Every citation link here is transcribed by an AI research pass from gazettetracker.com (a third-party aggregator), not independently re-checked against the primary PDF by a human — source project detail in the article above. Coverage is a bounded research sample (2,591 notifications across 53 ministries), not a complete or official gazette index. For a specific notification's authoritative citation history, consult egazette.gov.in or the ministry concerned directly.

        Data: gazette_trail.json, plain and freely downloadable. Part of masaladeutsch.blogspot.com.
